# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Anthropic Expands Verified Access to Cyber Models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-cyber-verification-expands.html): Anthropic is widening its Cyber Verification Program, giving more vetted security teams access to capable models under reduced defensive safeguards.
- [Cursor iOS App Adds Remote Control for Local Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cursor-ios-local-agent-control.html): Cursor’s new iOS feature lets developers monitor and message agents running on their own computers, extending coding workflows beyond the desktop.
- [Google Releases Multimodal EmbeddingGemma 2](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/embeddinggemma-2-on-device.html): Google released an open 740-million-parameter embedding model that maps text, code, images, audio and video into one space for local retrieval.
- [Meta Open-Sources Rebalancer for Large-Scale Assignment](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-rebalancer-open-source.html): Meta has released the C++ and Python solver used across dozens of large-scale allocation problems involving servers, traffic, and machine-learning workloads.
- [Mistral Opens Preview of One-Trillion-Parameter Large 4](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/mistral-large-4-preview.html): Mistral opened a public preview of its one-trillion-parameter multimodal model, pairing frontier claims with a promise of open weights later this month.
- [OpenAI Publishes Frontier Model Mathematics Results](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-mathematics-results.html): OpenAI released new mathematical results, Lean formalizations and compute disclosures while outlining a more transparent path for AI-assisted science.
- [DeepSeek reportedly seeks $12 billion before 2027 IPO](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/deepseek-funding-ipo.html): DeepSeek is reportedly nearing an $12 billion funding round backed by Tencent and CATL, underscoring the capital race behind Chinese AI.
- [Amazon brings Z.ai’s GLM 5.3 to Bedrock globally](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/glm-53-amazon-bedrock.html): Amazon Bedrock now offers Z.ai’s 753-billion-parameter GLM 5.3 with compatible APIs, prompt caching and managed cross-region inference.
- [Reflection opens 501B Beam model for coding and agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/reflection-beam-open-weight-model.html): Reflection AI has released Beam, a 501-billion-parameter open-weight model that targets coding, reasoning and long-horizon agent workloads.
- [Aleph Alpha Releases 78B Kolibri Open-Weight Model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/aleph-alpha-kolibri-open-weight-model.html): Aleph Alpha releases a German-English MoE model with 78.1 billion parameters, 3.46 billion active per token and Apache 2.0 licensing.
- [Study Finds Chinese Models Echo Official Views on Taboo Topics](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/chinese-models-political-bias-study.html): An Aleph Alpha benchmark finds Qwen, DeepSeek and Kimi often refuse or reproduce official positions across 967 politically sensitive prompts.
- [OpenAI Safety Report Author Resigns, Citing a Broken Culture](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-safety-culture-resignation.html): David Robinson, who led OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework and supervised safety reports for 12 frontier launches, says the company’s deployment culture has outpaced the safeguards needed for increasingly capable AI systems.
- [Apple Tightens macOS Disk Access as AI Agents Expand](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/apple-tightens-macos-agent-access.html): Apple will add stricter controls to macOS Full Disk Access, responding to privacy risks created by increasingly autonomous desktop AI agents.
- [BootLoops Open-Sources Tools for Exact Science Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/bootloops-scientific-agent-tools.html): BootLoops releases an open toolkit that gives AI agents certified computational tools for high-precision physics and quantitative research.
- [FieldAI完成7亿美元融资，估值达100亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/fieldai-robotics-funding-round.html): FieldAI据报已完成7亿美元Series C融资，估值达到100亿美元，用一套自主系统覆盖人形机器人、无人机和工业机器人。

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Anthropic扩大网络安全模型的验证访问计划](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-cyber-verification-expands.html): Anthropic扩大Cyber Verification Program，为更多经过核验的安全团队提供能力更强、限制更少的模型访问。
- [Cursor iOS 新增本地编程智能体远程控制](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cursor-ios-local-agent-control.html): Cursor推出本地智能体远程控制功能，开发者可通过iPhone查看进度并发送指令，让编程任务脱离桌面继续运行。
- [Google发布可端侧运行的多模态EmbeddingGemma 2](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/embeddinggemma-2-on-device.html): Google发布开放的7.4亿参数多模态嵌入模型，可将文本、代码、图像、音频和视频映射到同一空间。
- [Meta开源大规模资源分配求解器Rebalancer](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-rebalancer-open-source.html): Meta开源内部资源分配工具Rebalancer，称其已用于数十个大规模资源分配问题，涉及服务器、流量和机器学习任务。
- [Mistral开放一万亿参数Large 4预览版](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/mistral-large-4-preview.html): Mistral上线一万亿参数多模态模型Large 4公开预览，并承诺月底前发布权重，主打编程、智能体与网络安全。
- [OpenAI公布前沿模型生成的数学研究成果](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-mathematics-results.html): OpenAI发布一批由内部前沿模型产出的数学成果，同时公开Lean形式化证明、推理摘要与计算量信息。
- [DeepSeek据报拟融资120亿美元，冲刺2027年IPO](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/deepseek-funding-ipo.html): 据报道，DeepSeek正接近完成一轮至少800亿元人民币融资，腾讯和宁德时代是主要支持者，目标或指向2027年上市。
- [亚马逊将智谱GLM 5.3接入Bedrock云平台](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/glm-53-amazon-bedrock.html): 亚马逊云宣布在Bedrock提供智谱GLM 5.3，支持兼容OpenAI的API、提示词缓存和跨区域推理。
- [Reflection开源5010亿参数Beam模型，主攻编程智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/reflection-beam-open-weight-model.html): Reflection AI发布首个开源权重模型Beam，总参数量达5010亿，面向编程、推理和长程智能体任务。
- [Aleph Alpha发布78B开源权重模型Kolibri](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/aleph-alpha-kolibri-open-weight-model.html): Aleph Alpha发布德英双语MoE模型Kolibri，总参数78.1B、单次激活约3.46B，并采用Apache 2.0许可。
- [研究称多款中国模型对敏感议题复述官方立场](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/chinese-models-political-bias-study.html): Aleph Alpha测试Qwen、DeepSeek和Kimi在967个敏感议题上的表现，发现它们频繁拒答、回避或复述官方叙事。
- [OpenAI安全报告负责人离职，称公司文化已经“崩坏”](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-safety-culture-resignation.html): 曾负责OpenAI Preparedness Framework并监督12次前沿模型发布安全报告的David Robinson离职，警告持续冲刺式部署正在超过AI安全保障能力。
- [苹果收紧 macOS 全盘访问权限，应对 AI 代理风险](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/apple-tightens-macos-agent-access.html): 苹果将加强 macOS“全盘访问”控制，要求用户更明确地授权，以应对桌面 AI 代理带来的隐私风险。
- [BootLoops开源面向科学代理的精确计算工具](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/bootloops-scientific-agent-tools.html): BootLoops发布开源工具包，为AI代理提供高精度物理和定量科学计算能力，并配套可复用的代理技能协议。
- [FieldAI完成7亿美元融资，估值达100亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/fieldai-robotics-funding-round.html): 据报FieldAI已完成7亿美元Series C融资，估值达到100亿美元，用一套自主系统覆盖人形机器人、无人机和工业机器人。

- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-10-07.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
